summary: Parallel diagonal lines of different colors are aligned at both ends to match the second-longest line's extent.
src: diagonal lines of different colors s
dst: aligned position matching the second-longest line's endpoints d
match_cond: s.endpoints align with d.endpoints where d is the line with second-longest length
transform: extend or trim s so both endpoints align with the reference line's extent
multi_step: Step 1: identify all diagonal lines by color; Step 2: calculate each line's length; Step 3: find the second-longest line as reference; Step 4: align all other lines' endpoints to match the reference line's start and end positions
